ResearchProjectDef.label: neural severance
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study Slorg transceiver implants well enough to cut them out without killing the host. Unlocks the Sever link surgery, which frees a severed drone from the collective for good.

ResearchProjectDef.label: nanoprobe detection
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to find Slorg nanoprobes that have gone dormant in a host. Unlocks the Nanoprobe scan surgery, the only way to catch a sleeper agent before they rise up.
